_comment: Sensor Dashboard (viewer) configuration. Lists the same sensors defined on the Pi side so the dashboard charts them. Edit to choose which sensors appear and how they look — no recompile. Anything omitted falls back to a built-in default. Health stations are also config-driven so additional stations do not require dashboard code changes.

health_stations.name: John McCormack Field Station
health_stations.location: John McCormack Rd NE · Washington, DC

_sensors_note: Only the sensors listed here are shown, in this order. Use a plain string for defaults, or an object to override name/unit/colour/axis. Set visible:false to keep an entry on file but hide its chart. IMPORTANT: each id must match an id the Pi actually publishes (see the root config.json, and check GET /sensors on the API). A non-empty list here is treated as authoritative and suppresses sensor discovery entirely, so an id with no data behind it draws a permanently empty chart rather than being skipped.

sensors._comment: Derived at ingest from Inflow Weir Head using the configured V-notch equation. No values are published below the configured minimum credible head.
sensors.name: Inflow Flow Rate

sensors._comment: The MaxBotix MB7389-100 in the standpipe is read over /dev/serial0 on GPIO15/RXD0 and uses GPIO25 for its trigger in the field runtime configuration. The previous HC-SR04/UART GPIO conflict has been removed by moving HC-SR04 TRIG to GPIO17. MaxBotix serial reception is still under investigation because standalone exact-trigger testing has not yet produced UART bytes; keep the sensor visible so its eventual data and health state remain apparent.
sensors.name: Ponding Depth
